VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Domain Expansion: Skyfall
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Skyfall, Uro's domain, closed behind a barrier. Every second and a half, Thin Ice-Breaker lands on everyone inside who isn't her ally, a sure hit: their psycast shields and buffs are stripped, shield belts break, armour stops counting for a while, and the shockwave hits through it. It collapses if she leaves it, and a more refined domain overlapping it, or one with no barrier, makes it collapse.\n\nOpening it costs half a psyfocus bar (less with a lower psyfocus cost) and leaves her neural heat at 90% of her limit. When three or more domains meet, all of them collapse and their casters burn out.
